decisions.reason: The necessary artifact impact is already captured by the same-message MODIFY setting reshoot_required to true; no additional update or removal is needed.
The instruction changes script adherence and requires a reshoot but does not change the required tap confidence or timing.
The source does not alter or cancel the cozy home-interior filming setting.
The source does not change the opening performance of acting as though the question is being read from the phone.
Exact adherence to the script does not change the requirement that the spoken language be Arabic MSA.
The reshoot and exact-script instruction does not modify shared-link accessibility.
The source changes the video performance but does not change the required direct-chat delivery channel.
Requiring every phrase to be spoken exactly as written does not explicitly modify or remove the existing below-one-minute duration limit.
